items.text: The Maple Leafs are newly without John Tavares, and have been without Chris Tanev since Oct 10.
William Nylander has a point in six straight games against San Jose, and 12 points in his last six against them.
Morgan Rielly is two goals from 100.
The Sharks’ record (.562) is well ahead of what their chances are worth (.380), largely thanks to their goaltending.
